title: The Cover-Up
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'The Cover-Up,' Michael becomes suspicious of Donna's fidelity, prompting Dwight to suggest logic-based methods, including seduction, to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, the office experiences humorous interactions, conflicts, and revelations about relationships and character dynamics, with ongoing investigations and misunderstandings.
